question.text: An investment proposal coming to the IC of 'Lotus Growth' Cat II AIF should typically contain which of the following information as per chapter best practice?

answer.text: Executive Summary, Company Overview, Market and Industry Overview, Financial Overview, Risks and Key DD areas, Valuation Overview, Exit strategy, Deal Structure/Term Sheet, and Recommendations
Only the proposed investment amount and valuation
Only the founder's personal references and educational background
A single-page summary restricted to pricing and expected IRR

explanation.text: The Logic: Pages 302-303 describe an investment proposal that includes Executive Summary, Company Overview, Market and Industry Overview, Financial Overview, Risks and Key DD Areas, Valuation Overview, Exit, Deal Structure and Term Sheet Conditions, and Recommendations with proposed investment size and structure. The Trap: Options B and D understate the required content. Option C is irrelevant to IC decision-making. Note: A standardised IC-memo template across all deals helps preserve the source-listed content blocks consistently from one proposal to the next.
